injuries.comment: Flemings (back) is questionable to play Sunday against the Pistons.
Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.
Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Robinson (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
White (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Sacramento.
Tatum (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings.
Williams is probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a left thumb sprain.
Powell is questionable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a right hamstring strain.
Smith (illness) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Washington (illness/shoulder) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
Lawal (groin) is out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Holland (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Atlanta.
Okorie (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Atlanta.
Cunningham (knee) is probable to play Sunday in Atlanta.
Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.
Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Williams (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.
Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
McConnell (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday's game in New York.
Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.
Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Gardner (hamstring) is probable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.
Antetokounmpo (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
Towns (illness) won't play in Saturday's game versus the Trail Blazers.
Clarkson (foot) won't play in Saturday's game against Portland.
Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Trail Blazers.
Gilgeous-Alexander (back/neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus Miami.
Topic (hip) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus the Heat.
Williams (back) is listed as out for Sunday's game against Miami.
Caruso (hip) won't play Sunday against the Heat.

Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.
Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho
Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.
Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.
Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
